BUILDING_ALHAMBRA.long: This large fortified palace complex features a prominent, tall square tower rising from its center, surrounded by lower buildings with numerous red clay-tiled roofs. The structures are primarily reddish-brown brick or stucco, accented by lighter beige-colored walls. Multiple inner courtyards are visible, one featuring a small blue pool. Smaller square towers and arched gateways punctuate the perimeter. The complex sits on a light-colored, elevated base, bordered by small, dark green trees, under bright daylight with a warm color palette of reds, browns, and light cream.
BUILDING_ALHAMBRA.short: A fortified palace complex with a tall central square tower and multiple red-tiled roofs surrounding courtyards.

BUILDING_AMUNDSEN_SCOTT_RESEARCH_STATION.long: A contemporary architectural complex composed of several dark grey, multi-story rectangular buildings with black roofs. A large, white parabolic satellite dish is mounted atop a central, elevated structure. Modular sections extend from this core, featuring orange accent panels and small windows. In the foreground, a large, faceted silver geodesic dome sits on the ground. To the right, an external orange staircase leads up to one of the building modules. Two small orange and grey vehicles are positioned in front of the dome, indicating the facility's large scale. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the grey, black, silver, and orange color palette.
BUILDING_AMUNDSEN_SCOTT_RESEARCH_STATION.short: A modern complex features a large satellite dish on a central building, surrounded by modular structures and a geodesic dome.

BUILDING_ANGKOR_WAT.long: This complex wonder features a central, multi-tiered golden spire, surrounded by four slightly smaller, similarly gilded spires, all resting on an intricate, multi-level base of light-colored stone. The lower sections of the buildings are accented with teal-colored roofs or decorative panels and small patches of pink flora. The entire structure is brightly illuminated, suggesting daytime, highlighting the rich color palette of dominant gold and white, complemented by vivid teal and soft pink details. The architectural scale implies a grand and ornate temple.
BUILDING_ANGKOR_WAT.short: A temple complex with a central, tall golden tiered spire, flanked by four smaller golden spires, on a white and teal base.

BUILDING_APADANA.long: This multi-tiered architectural complex features a large central tan stone building with a prominent colonnade of deep red columns and royal blue friezes, capped by a crenellated roof with golden spikes. Flanking it are smaller, two-story tan stone buildings with flat roofs and blue trim. The entire structure is built on elevated platforms accessed by multiple staircases. A golden animal statue rests on a lower platform. Small conical green trees punctuate the scene. The lighting is bright daylight, casting soft shadows across the tan stone, red columns, and blue accents.
BUILDING_APADANA.short: Tan stone palace with a prominent central colonnade of red columns and blue friezes.

BUILDING_BIG_BEN.long: A tall, ornate clock tower with a rectangular light-colored stone base topped by a wider section featuring four prominent white clock faces, each framed in gold. Above this, a dark blue-grey spire rises, adorned with dormer windows and gilded architectural details, culminating in a pointed finial. The tower showcases multiple tiers of arches and columns. No surrounding environment is visible, presenting a direct portrait of the structure. The color palette primarily consists of light beige stone, rich gold accents, and a dark blue-grey spire under bright, even lighting.
BUILDING_BIG_BEN.short: Ornate clock tower with a dark blue spire, featuring four golden-framed clock faces.

BUILDING_BIOSPHERE.long: A spherical geodesic dome, constructed from numerous triangular clear panels within a white skeletal frame, dominates the scene. It rests on a gently sloping grassy mound, accessible by a winding brown path. The entire structure is set within a curving, light-colored concrete or stone base, partially enclosed by a low wall. Small conical green trees are planted along the base, and a short staircase leads down from the base at the foreground. The wonder is brightly lit by daylight, with blue tones visible through the dome's clear panels, contrasting with the green grass and white architectural elements.
BUILDING_BIOSPHERE.short: A large, clear geodesic dome with white structural framing sits on a grassy mound, surrounded by a light-colored walled base and winding paths.

BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATRE.long: This multi-tiered classical-style building features a prominent lower section with a columned portico, a triangular pediment, and a gilded sculpture atop the pediment. The main structure behind rises higher, also topped with a pediment and a dark sloped roof. The walls are constructed from light-colored stone, possibly marble or limestone, providing a stately appearance. The roofs are a deep blue-gray. The structure stands in isolation against a plain background, without any discernible surroundings or human-scale elements, emphasizing its monumental form. Even, bright lighting illuminates the building from above, highlighting its architectural details.
BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATRE.short: Classical-style building with a prominent front portico of columns and a gilded rooftop sculpture.

BUILDING_BROADWAY.long: The wonder is an urban block composed of several multi-story buildings of varying heights. Most are modern high-rises with flat roofs and blocky forms, some with numerous windows and illuminated digital billboards. One building, more classical in style, features a colonnaded entrance with an arched roofline at its base. The buildings are tightly packed on a dark grey paved surface, resembling a dense city center. Facades are in shades of grey, white, and brown. The scene is lit by numerous vibrant, glowing signs in red, blue, yellow, and white, suggesting a nighttime or twilight setting.
BUILDING_BROADWAY.short: A cluster of modern city buildings featuring illuminated digital billboards and a classical-style bank building.

BUILDING_CASA_DE_CONTRATACION.long: The wonder is a large, rectangular classical-style building with multiple stories. Its main facade is a warm pinkish-red, contrasting with light cream-colored stone used for the base, window frames, cornices, and a prominent balustrade along the flat roof. Small, pointed spires rise from each corner of the main roof and from smaller structures on top. The building is situated on a paved city street, featuring a small, white stone fountain with green foliage in the foreground. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows and highlighting the building's cream, pink-red, and dark window accents.
BUILDING_CASA_DE_CONTRATACION.short: A multi-story classical building with pink-red walls, light stone trim, and a balustraded flat roof with corner spires.

BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA.long: A Mesoamerican-style stepped pyramid wonder. Its multi-tiered base features prominent twin staircases, each adorned with small golden bowls, leading to a central, multi-level structure at its apex. This upper building has a flat, square roof and two archways at its front. The construction primarily uses reddish-brown stone or brick, accented with teal and green trim along the edges of the steps and upper platforms. Golden-yellow detailing highlights the decorative elements and the roof structure. The wonder is presented with bright, even lighting, showcasing its intricate details.
BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA.short: A Mesoamerican stepped pyramid with twin staircases leading to a rectangular temple on its summit.

BUILDING_COLOSSEUM.long: The image displays a massive, circular ancient arena, viewed from an isometric high angle. It features multiple grand tiers of arched entrances and columns, constructed from light-colored stone. The top-most levels are visibly unfinished, revealing a reddish-brown framework or scaffolding, indicating ongoing construction. The completed lower tiers show intricate architectural details. The structure's immense size dominates the frame. The color palette is primarily pale cream and beige for the stone, accented by darker brown and red-orange elements on the incomplete top and some architectural trim. The lighting is bright and even across the entire structure.
BUILDING_COLOSSEUM.short: A large, circular multi-tiered arena built from light stone, with the upper sections appearing unfinished and showing framework.

BUILDING_COLOSSUS.long: A colossal gilded statue depicts a male figure wearing a spiky crown and a draped garment over one shoulder. He holds a long, golden spear upright in his right hand and a small, shallow bowl in his left. The statue gleams with the warm, reflective finish of gilded bronze or gold. It stands on a low, circular, terraced base of white and grey stone, which in turn rests on a rugged, brown rocky outcrop. The immense size of the figure suggests a monumental scale. The dominant color is the bright, metallic gold of the statue. The base features muted tones of grey, white, and brown. Bright, even lighting illuminates the structure.
BUILDING_COLOSSUS.short: A colossal gilded statue of a crowned man holding a spear and a bowl, standing on a rocky island base.

BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR.long: A large, white stone statue of a robed figure with outstretched arms stands on a tall, rectangular pedestal. The figure has a smooth, stylized form. The pedestal rests on a multi-tiered, octagonal base with steps leading up to it, flanked by decorative elements resembling balustrades. The entire structure is rendered in a light, almost white stone, with some darker grey lines defining its edges and shadows. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows, and emphasizes the statue's monumental scale.
BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR.short: A monumental white stone statue of a robed figure with outstretched arms on a tall, tiered base.

BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER.long: The Eiffel Tower is a towering, reddish-brown wrought iron lattice structure forming a four-legged pyramidal shape, tapering to a slender spire. The four arched legs at the base merge into a single broad shaft, with two visible viewing platforms before the top section. It stands on a light grey paved surface, which features circular green landscaped areas at the base of each leg. The overall scale is monumental, dominating the immediate surroundings. The color palette is earthy browns for the metal, light greys for the pavement, and greens for the foliage, under bright, even daytime lighting.
BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER.short: A towering, reddish-brown wrought iron lattice tower with four arched legs, tapering to a slender spire, on a paved surface.

BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA.long: The central feature is a large, modern circular stadium with a ribbed, slightly domed white roof and multiple tiers of seating, including sections in green and blue. The stadium complex sits on a wide, grey paved area. To the left, a smaller circular building with a silver dome complements the main structure. Several rectangular, multi-story buildings with light grey and glass facades are visible on the right. A plaza in front features small, colorful rectangular markers in blue, yellow, green, and red, with some interspersed green landscaping. The scene is brightly lit by day, using a palette of white, greys, and blues with touches of green and primary colors.
BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA.short: A massive, modern circular stadium with a ribbed, slightly domed white roof, surrounded by supporting buildings and a paved plaza.

BUILDING_ETEMENANKI.long: The wonder is a large, multi-tiered ziggurat constructed from light brown stone or brick. Each of its four receding levels features a distinctive royal blue tiled trim along its upper edges. A wide central staircase with white steps ascends from the ground to the first tier, followed by a narrower one to the second, and a small, square building caps the very top. Small golden accents, possibly decorative lamps, are present at the base of the staircase and on corners of some tiers. The structure stands on a flat, light brown base, brightly and evenly lit by daylight.
BUILDING_ETEMENANKI.short: A multi-tiered ziggurat with receding levels, blue-tiled edges, and a grand central staircase.

BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY.long: A multi-tiered East Asian-style building features prominently. It has several golden, curving tiled roofs with prominent eaves, supported by a structure of bright red columns and teal-green decorative friezes. The building rests on a robust light grey stone block base, accessible by a central staircase. The architectural form suggests a grand palace or temple of significant scale. The entire structure is brightly illuminated, with the vibrant gold, red, and green elements standing out against the muted grey stone. The background is a plain dark void.
BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY.short: Multi-tiered East Asian-style building with golden tiled roofs, bright red columns, and a light grey stone base.

BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE.long: A massive, brightly lit red-orange suspension bridge features two tall, rectangular towers with intricate internal cross-bracing. A wide, light grey asphalt roadway, designed for two lanes of traffic, is supported between the towers and extends outwards. The structure is painted in a distinctive red-orange, likely metal, with bases and surrounding supports in light grey concrete or stone. The bridge spans dark, calm water, connecting on its right side to a small, rugged dark brown rocky island. The left side terminates mid-span, implying it continues across a larger body of water. Bright daylight illuminates the bridge directly, highlighting its vibrant color against the darker water.
BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE.short: A brightly lit red-orange suspension bridge with twin towers and a wide roadway, spanning dark water.

BUILDING_GREAT_BATH.long: A grand, multi-tiered palace features two large, bulbous golden domes atop flanking towers. The central structure rises in receding terraces, adorned with green and red patterned friezes and numerous arched openings. A stepped blue water canal leads up to the main entrance. Constructed from reddish-brown stone or stucco with gold accents, the wonder is flanked by smaller, simpler buildings and sparse green trees, set on reddish-brown ground. Bright daylight illuminates the warm palette of browns, golds, and reds, contrasted with the cool blues of the water.
BUILDING_GREAT_BATH.short: An ornate, multi-tiered palace with two prominent golden domes, patterned friezes, and a stepped blue water feature.

BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY.long: The wonder is a complex of classical-style buildings constructed from light beige stone, featuring terracotta tiled roofs. The central and tallest structure boasts a large circular dome, capped with a white statue of a draped figure standing on a pedestal. Below the dome, a circular colonnade supports the roof. The main facade presents a grand entrance accessed by stairs, adorned with two large gilded urns. Two medium-sized buildings flank the central structure, and two smaller, detached buildings are also present, all sharing the same light stone walls and orange-brown tiled roofs. The scene is brightly lit, with no discernible surrounding environment.
BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY.short: A central domed building topped with a statue, flanked by smaller structures, all with light stone walls and terracotta roofs.

BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE.long: This multi-tiered lighthouse is constructed from light grey or white stone. It features a broad square base, followed by a slightly narrower square middle section, and a cylindrical top section culminating in a golden spire. Golden statues adorn the corners of the middle section, and a large golden figure stands atop the cylinder. The structure rests on a dark, rocky base with a small, arched entrance. The golden figures provide a sense of its grand scale. The dominant colors are the pale stone and the gleaming gold accents, set against a dark base. It is brightly illuminated, suggesting daytime.
BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE.short: A multi-tiered white stone lighthouse topped with a golden statue and spire.

BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE.long: Three tall, smooth, light-grey, egg-shaped structures, each encircled by horizontal yellow-gold bands, stand as the central architectural elements. They are set within curved, low stone walls enclosing a grassy area. Two smaller, rounded, straw-colored hut-like structures with domed roofs are also present inside this enclosure. Thin, vertical, dark elements protrude from the top of the curved walls, possibly totems. A large, dense green tree canopy rises behind and above the structures. The scene is brightly lit by daylight, with a dominant color palette of light grey, vibrant yellow-gold, and lush green.
BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE.short: Conical, banded stone structures are set amidst low walls and a vibrant green tree.

BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA.long: The structure features a dominant central dome, numerous smaller domes, and a tiered rectangular base constructed from warm orange-red brick and lighter stone. Four very tall, slender minarets, topped with pointed conical spires, rise from the corners. Arches and windows are visible throughout the walls. This monumental building stands on a green base with a few small surrounding structures and trees, indicating its grand scale within a city setting. The color palette is characterized by the brick and stone, complemented by light blue-grey domes and minarets, and a gilded finial on the main dome. It is brightly and evenly lit, suggesting daytime.
BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA.short: A grand structure featuring a large central blue dome, surrounded by four tall, slender minarets and smaller domes.

BUILDING_HALICARNASSUS_MAUSOLEUM.long: This multi-tiered wonder features a white stone base with a prominent colonnade, adorned with golden trim and blue friezes. Stepped roofs lead to a smaller, recessed upper section, which itself culminates in a pointed, stepped roof. The structure is heavily embellished with gilded accents, including roof edges, column capitals, and decorative elements. Golden lion statues flank the wide steps at the base, and a golden equestrian statue crowns the very top. The entire monument is rendered in bright white and gold, under clear, even daylight, suggesting a monumental scale.
BUILDING_HALICARNASSUS_MAUSOLEUM.short: A tiered white and gold temple topped with a golden equestrian statue and flanked by lion sculptures.

BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS.long: The wonder is a grand, multi-tiered structure, rising in stepped terraces. Its architectural form features a rectangular base with four corner towers and a central, taller section. Blue and sandy-gold striped bands adorn the stone or brick facade of each level. Lush green foliage, resembling trees and cascading plants, spills from the terraces, creating a vivid hanging garden effect. The central tower is capped with a prominent golden, possibly domed or inverted bowl-shaped, finial. The structure is brightly lit under what appears to be daylight, highlighting the vibrant blue, gold, and green colors.
BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS.short: Multi-tiered terraced structure with blue and gold bands, featuring green hanging gardens and a golden finial at its peak.

BUILDING_HERMITAGE.long: This wonder is a massive, multi-winged building with a complex footprint, likely a palace or museum. Its facade is light-colored stone, adorned with numerous classical elements including pilasters, arched windows, and balustrades. The distinctive roofs are a dark teal-green, punctuated by small golden spires. In the foreground, a tall, slender bronze monument with a dark, pointed top rises from a light stone pedestal. The structure is depicted under bright, even daylight on a flat, paved surface, suggesting an urban setting.
BUILDING_HERMITAGE.short: A grand, multi-winged palace of light stone with dark teal roofs and a tall, slender bronze monument in the foreground.

BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI.long: The wonder is a large, stepped pyramid or ziggurat with receding levels. A grand, double-flight staircase ascends the front, splitting into two separate, wide staircases. On the uppermost tier, two smaller, identical temples with pointed roofs stand side-by-side. The structure appears to be constructed from light-colored stone or stucco, possibly limestone. It features prominent blue-teal tile or painted sections along the edges of the tiers and on the upper temples, with golden trim accenting the stair railings and temple roofs. The monument is brightly lit from above, showcasing its white, blue, and gold color scheme against a dark background, indicating its monumental scale.
BUILDING_HUEY_TEOCALLI.short: A tiered stone pyramid with twin temples on top and a grand double-staircase, featuring prominent blue and gold accents.

BUILDING_JEBEL_BARKAL.long: This wonder displays a complex of light-colored stone buildings, featuring several prominent conical or pyramidal towers and two tall, slender pylons. The largest tower in the foreground has a stepped base, tapering to a gilded cap, with green and reddish-brown bands. Smaller similar towers and rectangular buildings with flat roofs complete the ensemble, many adorned with green and red-brown trim and gilded accents. The structures are built on a green and earthy plain, nestled against a massive, reddish-brown rock formation. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the contrast between the pale stone, vibrant green, and deep red-brown elements.
BUILDING_JEBEL_BARKAL.short: A complex of white and green buildings with multiple conical towers and two tall pylons, set against a red mountain.

BUILDING_KILWA_KISIWANI.long: A large, light-brown stone complex features high perimeter walls topped with a distinctive teal trim and small blue-green domed turrets at each corner. A prominent central building rises with a large, ornate teal dome and arched gateways. Inside the walled enclosure, two courtyards are visible, each containing green trees with orange fruits. The complex is depicted under bright, even daylight, presented from an isometric viewpoint on flat, unadorned ground. The primary color palette combines sandy beige stone with striking teal and bright green accents from the foliage.
BUILDING_KILWA_KISIWANI.short: A large, walled complex features a prominent central teal dome and courtyard gardens.

BUILDING_KOTOKU_IN.long: A colossal, gilded copper Buddha statue dominates the scene, seated in a meditative pose on a tiered, cylindrical light-beige stone base. The central statue is surrounded by a courtyard of four small, East Asian-style buildings, each with dark green, pitched roofs and light tan walls. Pink lanterns hang between the buildings and from the central base. The entire structure rests on a light-colored paved ground, accented by small pink flowering bushes and a miniature white stupa. The scene is brightly lit from above, showcasing a palette of radiant gold, deep greens, and warm beige stone.
BUILDING_KOTOKU_IN.short: A colossal, gilded Buddha statue sits on a stone base, surrounded by small, dark-roofed buildings forming a courtyard.

BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU.long: The wonder is a terraced mountain city, composed of extensive gray stone retaining walls supporting multiple levels of green agricultural fields and numerous small, white-walled houses with brown thatched roofs. Winding stone paths and stairs connect the various tiers. At the highest point, a larger, multi-story white building with a distinctive blue-green roof and trim stands prominently. The entire structure is built into natural dark rock formations at its base, suggesting a rugged, elevated setting. Bright, even lighting illuminates the earthy color palette of greens, grays, browns, and whites, accented by blue-green and small pink flowers.
BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU.short: A terraced mountain settlement featuring stone retaining walls, many small thatched-roof houses, and a prominent white central building.

BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE.long: This wonder is a tall, slender, multi-tiered tower constructed from white or light-colored stone. Its main body consists of several diminishing rectangular tiers, each adorned with repeating decorative patterns and golden accents. The pinnacle tapers into an ornate, gilded spire. Flanking the lower tiers are smaller, elaborate structures with curved roofs. The entire monument rests on a flat, light-colored paved ground with subtle floral details, illuminated brightly from above, casting soft shadows. The color palette is primarily white, cream, and gold.
BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE.short: A tall, multi-tiered white and gold spire rises from a decorated stone base.

BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE.long: The wonder is a grand complex of South Asian-style temples, dominated by a towering, stepped central structure. This main building is composed of numerous ornate levels, primarily reddish-orange brick or terracotta, with distinctive turquoise and teal roofing and decorative elements. Two smaller, similar tiered temples flank the central structure. The entire complex rests on a large, multi-tiered stone platform with integrated water features and small, manicured trees and shrubs, resembling cypress or palm trees. Clear daylight illuminates the warm earthy tones of the buildings, contrasting with the vibrant teal and deep green foliage.
BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE.short: A large, multi-tiered temple complex features a central, towering reddish-orange structure with teal accents, surrounded by smaller temples and lush greenery.

BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL.long: A multi-layered stone abbey features a prominent, tall central spire with a steep blue-grey roof and a green finial. Surrounding the central structure are numerous smaller buildings with matching blue-grey pitched roofs and light tan walls, supported by visible buttresses. The entire complex is set atop a grey, octagonal-shaped fortified platform, creating an elevated and isolated appearance. The structure is depicted with bright, even daylight, highlighting its light beige stone and deep blue roofs against the darker grey base.
BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL.short: A tall central blue-roofed spire rises from a complex cluster of light stone buildings on a grey fortified base.

BUILDING_ORACLE.long: A circular temple features a central rotunda of white stone columns supporting a gilded dome. Atop the dome stands a golden statue of two embracing figures, framed by a crenellated golden rim at the dome's base. The rotunda rests on a wider, lower circular platform of light stone, adorned with a blue and cream checkered tile pattern. Four human-sized white stone statues, depicting archers, are evenly spaced around this outer platform, providing scale. The entire structure is brightly illuminated by even daylight, highlighting its cream, gold, and blue color palette.
BUILDING_ORACLE.short: A circular temple with a golden double-figure statue atop a domed rotunda, surrounded by archer statues on a tiled platform.

BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ.long: A vast, ornate palace complex built from light cream-colored stone, featuring a dominant central reddish-purple onion dome topped with a small spire. Symmetrical wings extend from the center, incorporating multiple levels, smaller domes, and pointed roofs with matching reddish-purple tiles. Architectural details include numerous arched windows and balconies. The structure sits on a raised, landscaped platform, surrounded by manicured grassy plots with small, conical evergreen trees, and a slender flagpole or monument. The scene is brightly lit from above, suggesting daytime, highlighting the cream stone, dark roofs, and green foliage.
BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ.short: A grand palace with a large central reddish-purple onion dome, flanked by multi-winged cream-colored stone structures and landscaped gardens.

BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY.long: The central feature is a multi-tiered, classical rotunda topped with a prominent blue dome, featuring gold accents. Surrounding it are several interconnected, two-story collegiate buildings constructed from light yellow stone, featuring blue-grey pitched roofs and arched walkways. A tall, dark gothic spire rises behind the main dome, and a smaller building with a green-blue dome sits in the foreground. The complex is set on green lawns with paved pathways, creating an academic campus feel. The lighting is bright daylight, highlighting the cream stone, various blue roofs, and dark spire.
BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY.short: Blue-domed classical rotunda surrounded by yellow-stone collegiate buildings and a tall gothic spire.

BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL.long: A large industrial canal complex features a central, tall lift bridge made of two prominent square wooden towers. The grey stone canal walls contain purple-tinted water, with a section of the bridge deck visibly raised between the towers. On the right bank, a brown brick building with a pointed roof and a tall chimney stands near a silo-like structure. A paved grey road leads up to both sides of the bridge. The surrounding land is covered with green grass and some brown earth. The scene is brightly lit by even daylight, showcasing a palette of grey, brown, orange-wood, and green.
BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL.short: A large grey industrial canal with a prominent wooden lift bridge and flanking stone buildings.

BUILDING_PETRA.long: A monumental building carved directly into a towering reddish-brown sandstone cliff. Its symmetrical facade features multiple stories with engaged columns, ornate pediments, and recessed niches. The top level has a central, gilded urn flanked by two smaller domed structures. The entire building is integrated into the surrounding natural rock formations, emphasizing its massive scale. At the base, two small market stalls with striped blue and red canopies provide a sense of human scale. The scene is brightly lit by even daylight, with a warm color palette dominated by the natural reddish-browns of the stone, complemented by white and gold accents.
BUILDING_PETRA.short: A multi-story building carved directly into a reddish-brown sandstone cliff, featuring columns, elaborate carvings, and an urn on the roof.

BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE.long: A sprawling multi-tiered palace complex built into a rocky hill. White and red-orange walls define the numerous levels, topped by distinctive gilded pagoda-style roofs. Long, straight staircases with red steps ascend the natural terrain, connecting different sections. A small blue pool is visible on the highest level. The structure dominates the elevated, rocky landscape, which features sparse green vegetation. The color palette consists of white stone, vibrant red-orange details, gleaming gold roofs, and dark blue water, under soft, clear daylight.
BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE.short: Gilded-roofed palace complex on a rocky hill with prominent red and white staircases.

BUILDING_PYRAMIDS.long: The wonder depicts three smooth-sided pyramids crafted from light limestone, featuring two larger and one smaller structure, all resting on a flat stone base. Golden accents highlight the corners and bases of the pyramids. In front of the larger pyramids, two substantial gilded statues stand on pedestals: one resembling a feline sphinx, the other a human figure. A row of four thin, carved stelae is positioned to the left. The entire complex is presented in an isolated, model-like view against a light background, suggesting a monumental scale in a desert setting. Predominantly off-white and light grey, the structures are brightly illuminated, casting soft shadows, with rich gold detailing providing contrast.
BUILDING_PYRAMIDS.short: Three smooth-sided white limestone pyramids with golden accents, flanked by golden statues and stelae.

BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY.long: A massive, reddish-orange steel headframe with diagonal supports dominates the center, towering over a complex of red brick industrial buildings. Below it, a multi-story brick building with a stepped roof serves as the main shaft house. To its left, a group of interconnected brick structures features several tall, slender smokestacks. Smaller, similar steel gantry structures are positioned on the far left and right. Grey pipes connect various parts of the complex, situated on dark green and grey paved ground. The bright reddish-orange steel and dark red-brown bricks are contrasted by grey and dark green under even daylight.
BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY.short: A tall, reddish-orange steel gantry rises over a red brick industrial complex with multiple smokestacks.

BUILDING_STATUE_LIBERTY.long: A colossal robed female figure, the Statue of Liberty is rendered in distinctive verdigris copper. She wears a spiked crown and holds a tablet in her left arm, while her right arm elevates a bright, fiery torch. The monumental statue stands on a multi-tiered stone pedestal and base, its scale immense without surrounding features. The statue's dominant blue-green hue contrasts with the vibrant orange and yellow of the torch flame. The pedestal exhibits shades of light gray and brown stone. The entire scene is uniformly and brightly illuminated.
BUILDING_STATUE_LIBERTY.short: A colossal verdigris copper statue of a robed woman holding a tablet and an elevated torch, on a stone pedestal.

BUILDING_STATUE_OF_ZEUS.long: The wonder is a large classical temple, primarily white and light gray stone, featuring a prominent colonnade and a pedimented entrance. Its dark roof is partially open, revealing a colossal, white-clad statue within. The temple stands on a grand, multi-tiered stone platform. Wide stairs lead up to the entrance, marked by a central blue carpet and golden railings. The elevated platform is surrounded by low, curved white walls and slender green cypress trees. No human figures are visible, but the large statue inside suggests a monumental scale. The dominant colors are the white and light gray stone, accented by gold trim, red banners, and the blue carpet. The scene is brightly lit by clear daylight.
BUILDING_STATUE_OF_ZEUS.short: A classical temple with an open roof housing a colossal statue, atop a grand tiered platform with blue-carpeted stairs.

BUILDING_STONEHENGE.long: Stonehenge is depicted as a circular megalithic monument featuring large, rough-hewn grey stones arranged in an outer ring of trilithons and uprights. Inside this ring, smaller upright bluestones form an inner circle and horseshoe shape. Several golden-capped wooden posts stand among the stones. The entire structure rests on a small, round, vibrant green grassy mound, suggesting a low hilltop setting. The scale of the stones appears large, dwarfing the inner posts. The scene is brightly and evenly lit, implying daytime under a diffuse light source, with a color palette dominated by earthy greens and various shades of grey stone, accented by the golden posts.
BUILDING_STONEHENGE.short: Stonehenge features large grey stone trilithons and uprights in a circular formation on a green hill.

BUILDING_ST_BASILS_CATHEDRAL.long: This elaborate structure features multiple towers of varying heights and shapes, including cylindrical, octagonal, and conical forms, each topped with a distinctive, intricately patterned onion dome. The domes are painted in vibrant colors like green, blue, and red, with white and gold accents. The main body of the building is predominantly red and orange with green-tiled roofs and white decorative elements. The structure stands alone on a simple light-colored base, suggesting a monumental scale. The lighting is bright and even, indicating daytime.
BUILDING_ST_BASILS_CATHEDRAL.short: A cluster of ornate, colorful onion-domed towers and spires with intricate patterns, rising from a white base.

BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE.long: The wonder features multiple large, fan-shaped white roofs, reminiscent of sails or shells, overlapping each other. These intricate, curving structures sit atop a sturdy, multi-level rectangular base. The base is predominantly a golden-brown, likely concrete or stone, with darker blue-grey window sections visible beneath the roofline. The overall form suggests a modern, complex architectural design. The image shows the building against a plain background, with bright, even lighting, indicating daytime. The color palette is dominated by the cream-white of the roofs and the warm brown of the base.
BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE.short: Multiple overlapping white shell-like roofs sit on a rectangular golden-brown base.

BUILDING_TAJ_MAHAL.long: The Taj Mahal is a symmetrical mausoleum, primarily constructed from pristine white marble. A large central dome dominates the structure, flanked by four smaller domes and four tall, slender minarets at each corner of the elevated platform. The building features multiple arched entryways and windows, with intricate decorative details visible in contrasting light brown stone accents and golden finials topping the domes. It rests on a broad, raised rectangular base, which has a reddish-orange and white geometric pattern around its perimeter. The scene is brightly lit from above, showcasing the monument's light color palette.
BUILDING_TAJ_MAHAL.short: A white marble mausoleum with a large central dome and four tall minarets at its corners, all on a patterned platform.

BUILDING_TEMPLE_ARTEMIS.long: A monumental, multi-tiered structure built from light-colored stone. The main building on top is a classical temple with columns, a central open courtyard, and a reddish-orange tiled roof. Large, symmetrical staircases with low walls lead up the stepped base, flanked by golden, stylized lion statues on the lower terraces. The wonder stands on a light tan-brown ground, indicating its scale. The dominant color palette includes off-white stone, terracotta roof tiles, and gold accents. The scene is brightly lit by direct daylight, casting subtle shadows.
BUILDING_TEMPLE_ARTEMIS.short: A multi-tiered classical temple with a tiled roof and large ascending staircases adorned with golden animal statues.

BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY.long: Nine male figures, resembling terracotta warriors, stand in an isometric formation. Each figure has a stern expression, a black topknot, and a mustache and beard. They wear long blue robes with red armored chest plates and white sashes, standing on simple light gray bases. The figures are depicted in a studio-like setting with a plain white background, suggesting a portrait or icon. They appear human-scale, arranged in three rows. The color palette features deep blues and bright reds for clothing, contrasted with black hair and light skin tones. Lighting is even and bright, casting minimal shadows.
BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY.short: Nine terracotta warrior-like figures stand in formation, wearing blue and red uniforms with black hair and beards.

BUILDING_TORRE_DE_BELEM.long: A multi-story grey stone fortress stands in dark blue water, featuring a square central tower with battlements and rounded turrets. Its fortified base extends outwards, with an open flat top made of tan stone. Small, rectangular windows dot the lower walls. To the right, a separate, elevated stone platform holds two small green trees, connected to the main structure by a raised path. The entire structure is isolated by the surrounding water, with steps leading down to it. The daytime lighting is even and bright, casting minimal shadows across the muted grey, tan, and blue palette.
BUILDING_TORRE_DE_BELEM.short: A grey stone fortress with a square, multi-story tower and battlements, surrounded by dark blue water.

BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE.long: This architectural complex features a prominent central, tiered Ziggurat-like structure built from light brown and beige stone. Its tall, pointed peak and stepped surfaces are adorned with numerous small, peg-like protrusions. To the right and behind, a walled courtyard contains several shallow pools of blue water and scattered green plants, including small palms. Smaller, similar tiered buildings extend from the left, one with a water spout. The complex suggests a desert setting, with a warm, earthy color palette under bright, even daytime lighting.
BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE.short: A tiered, sand-colored Ziggurat-like structure with a pointed peak and studded surfaces, flanked by walled courtyards and pools.

BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL.long: Two tall, rectangular clock towers stand side-by-side, each constructed with alternating tiers of orange-brown brick and light gray stone. The lower sections are stone, supporting brick middle sections that feature recessed panels. One panel displays a white clock face with black hands, the other a blue dial with white markings. Above the brick, each tower has a crenellated stone parapet, topped by a slender, dark spire. The towers are presented against a pure white background, illuminated by bright, even daylight, casting soft shadows. They appear to be monumental in scale, likely free-standing structures.
BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL.short: Two rectangular, multi-tiered clock towers made of orange brick and light gray stone, topped with crenellated parapets and small spires.
